audit_export: per-tick paired rows in the S503 paired_losses key shape (sport, game_key, ts, y, target outcome, segment None, losses {arm: {brier, logloss}}, contrast), decimal strings; an export only, never fed to scoreboard_cumulative
code_identity_rule: a run whose run-row sha256 map is absent, or lacks or differs on any code_identity file, is excluded code_identity_changed (counted); other files are not pinned
counting: every arm row counted by (arm, decision, reason) independently of fills, before pairing; games with no paired tick counted game_no_paired_tick
dedupe: key (game_key, arm, run_nonce, t_epoch); identical repeat counted duplicate_row; a repeat unequal on any field except row_id and emitted_ts refuses the whole read (exit 2, no output)
disclosures: calibration only; fills and markouts are out of scope (S516)
one corpus; the word is capped at SINGLE-WINDOW

estimand is conditional on blend availability (live, state age <= 180 s, p0 frozen pre-first-pitch); the per-game mid Brier on all mid-resolvable ticks is reported next to the paired-tick mid Brier as a descriptive selection check
the blend's p0 is a frozen venue pregame mid
recorder uptime gaps drop ticks, not games; games are assumed independent clusters

estimator.tails: p_ahead / p_behind as returned by boot

first_eligible_date_rule: UTC date of the committer instant of the only commit of the file's current incarnation (the seal is write-once) + 1 day
floor_rule: paired_games = settled eligible games with >= 1 paired tick; schedule_days = distinct schedule_day values among those games; the UTC scheduled_start date is used for eligibility only
labels: arm mid is named venue mid; the word devigged is not used
mid: ingame_scoreboard_rules._mid(book, state, entry): book = the unique record in <run argv --books-root>/kalshi/mlb/<book_src.path> (whole file) decoded by capture_watchdog.decode whose live_shadow_quoter.row_hash equals book_row_sha256, ticker equal to the row ticker, response_end_ts equal to book_ts and <= t_epoch; state = the unique record in <--state-root>/state/mlb/<state_src.path> whose row_hash equals state_raw_sha256; entry = the joined schedule entry; zero or several matches or a ValueError -> mid_unresolved:<reason>
multi_run: per game, runs ordered by first t_epoch; a later run's ticks kept only where t_epoch > the last t_epoch of every earlier kept run; the overlap counted duplicate_run
outcome: state shards for the schedule day, +1 and +2; last = max response_end_ts with status final; arm-row ticker != entry ticker -> ticker_mismatch; score_home == score_away or no final -> outcome_unsettled; else ingame_scoreboard_rules.ticker_outcome
pairing: tick = (game_key, run_nonce, t_epoch) with both arm rows; decision is ignored; a tick is paired when both arms are available; blend: model_prob_yes None -> unavailable, counted by the blend row's reason; non-None but non-finite or not strictly inside (0,1) -> blend_invalid; mid: unresolved -> mid_unresolved:<reason>; resolved but not strictly inside (0,1) -> mid_out_of_range; resolved, in range, and the mid row's book_age_s > the run row's freshness_bars.book_max_age_s -> mid_stale; otherwise available
population: game_keys present in arm rows joined to exactly one schedule entry (<day>_maker_forward.json; that <day> is the game's schedule_day); conflicts counted schedule_conflict; scheduled games with no rows counted no_rows; eligible when the UTC date of scheduled_start >= first_eligible_date, else game_before_eligible
stopping_rule: D* = the smallest schedule day such that the settled eligible games with schedule day <= D* meet both floors; the confirmatory set is exactly those games, read at or after 00:00:00Z of calendar date D* + 2; the confirmatory statistic is computed only by S519's own reader under this body; every other read is DESCRIPTIVE
verdict: floors unmet -> INSUFFICIENT; else ingame_scoreboard_rules.contrast_verdict(n_games, ci90 lo, ci90 hi, contrast=True) with n_corpora 1 (INSUFFICIENT / UNDERPOWERED / SINGLE-WINDOW, never AHEAD or BEHIND); sign and interval reported as numbers
weighting: each game one unit: per-game mean Brier and log-loss per arm over its paired ticks; per-game difference = blend minus mid; tick counts reported, never weights
